title: Published to crates.io: autodyne 0.1.1, the license as baseline 2026.10.8 renders it
body: The user asked for 0.1.1 (2026-10-31) and it was published from commit 3ec2650: the code as in 0.1.0 (two doc comments changed), the license texts and CONTACT.md as baseline 2026.10.8 renders them (the royalty-free option ends at USD 1,000,000 revenue or USD 3,000,000 funding; the texts provisional, accepted without a lawyer's review). Before publishing: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets with every feature CI builds (-D warnings), cargo test --workspace --all-targets and --doc, cargo publish --dry-run (190 files, 691 KiB compressed). crates.io shows 0.1.1 with the license GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Royalty-Free-1.0 OR LicenseRef-Commercial-1.0. 0.1.0 stays under the terms it shipped with.
